svg.text: Time series ingestion on a 3-node Raft cluster, verified on every node

g.text: ingest on one protocol, read on HTTP
ingest on one protocol, read on HTTP
The ingest connection varies with the protocol matrix; the three readers are always plain HTTP, one per node.
ingest = protocol against node 0; r0/r1/r2 = Protocol.SQL_HTTP, one per node, all in one try-with-resources
The schema is created through the ingest connection and checked on all three readers before any point is written.
Three threads ingest against node 0 while the writes replicate; 30000 points plus 4 verification points.
Counts are logged from all three readers during the load, then awaited until each reaches the exact total.
until(c0 == 30004 && c1 == 30004 && c2 == 30004) atMost 2 minutes, pollInterval 5s; RemoteException is retried
Each reader repeats the full single-server check, so a node that replicated only part of the data fails.
